headline: Coding tutorials score rises 78 to 87; kids songs debut at 83
paragraphs: 7 of the 61 niches tracked yesterday changed score. coding-tutorials rose 78 to 87 and career-resume-tips 73 to 79; cybersecurity-tips 57 to 60, no-code-automation 81 to 83 and business-case-studies 71 to 73. trading-app-tutorials fell 88 to 86 and ev-green-tech 87 to 86.

Biggest breakout: Play Learn Replay's "Be Careful On The Bus" in kids-songs-lullabies, 8,160.4x typical views (81,628,736 views, 28,300 subscribers); first score 83. In cybersecurity-tips, Real Talk with Asad's "7 Things You Should NEVER Tell AI" reached 791.7x, and the niche gained 7 channels.

Added fireplace-holiday-ambience ahead of the holidays: YouTube's own blog says fireplace videos had their highest daily viewership on Dec 24 and 25 in 2023. Thumbnails could not be loaded today: 2 channel entries, no thumbnail tags, niche notes from titles only.
